name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.49 V2
notes: The second revision. Panel reset moves onto the TCA9554 (pin 5), which means the panel cannot be reset before I2C is up — an ordering constraint the first revision does not have. GPIO 21 becomes the tearing line and GPIO 8 the expander's own interrupt, both of which were something else on V1. Audio is the third board to use the ES8311-out/ES7210-in pair, and the first to put both on their own I2C bus (47/48) separate from the touch bus (17/18) — every earlier board hung everything off one. The NS4150 amp enable sits on a TCA9554 at 0x20, pin 7, exactly like the AUDIO-Board's TCA9555: the speaker stays silent until an I2C transaction says otherwise, which is a fact about the board and not a fault in the firmware. The panel is an AXS15231B on quad SPI, a controller no profile has driven yet, and it is its own touch controller too — one part answering at 0x3b on the touch bus, rather than the separate FT3168 the watch carries. 172x640 is a bar: taller than it is wide by nearly four to one, which is a different interface problem from the watch's near-square and worth designing for rather than scaling into. Pins are read out of Waveshare's own repository for this board rather than the wiki, after the wiki named the wrong controller for the watch and cost an evening.

audio_in.notes: Shares the ES8311's MCLK/BCLK/LRCK, as on every board so far.
